name: 48026 · Fraser, MI
findings: ZIP 48026 (Fraser) has 44 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48026 (Fraser) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 48026 (Fraser) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
